TONTON · CUSTOM CAMO RASH GUARDS · OEM / ODM

Urban Shadow Short-Sleeve Rash Guard

Develop a distinctive No-Gi BJJ, MMA or team training collection around green urban camouflage and pale-white industrial-style graphics. This short-sleeve reference features a close-fitting silhouette, raglan panel lines, visible flat seam construction and coordinated chest, sleeve and upper-back artwork.

  • Monochrome black, charcoal and slate-grey camouflage
  • Hazard-style sleeve artwork and white 22 panel
  • TONTON chest insignias and Tactical Unit back graphic
  • Raglan short sleeves with visible cuff and hem stitching

Custom rash guard specifications

ProductShort-sleeve, close-fitting training rash guard
Color and artworkBlack / charcoal / slate-grey urban camo with white industrial-style graphics
Material and GSMPolyester / spandex blend direction; final composition and weight pending fabric approval
Sleeves and seamsRaglan sleeve layout with visible flat seams; confirm exact needle/thread construction on sample
Print developmentSublimation direction for custom camouflage and artwork; approve color, stretch appearance and wash durability
BrandingChest crests, sleeve graphics, upper-back Tactical Unit motif and lower-body data-style artwork
Training directionNo-Gi BJJ, MMA, wrestling, grappling and conditioning
Care proposalCold wash inside out, shade dry, no bleach or ironing on decoration; confirm final care label

Confirm stretch recovery, stitch strength, seam comfort and wash results before bulk production. Fabric weight, ripstop structure, abrasion protection and moisture-management performance are not established by photographs.

Compare the tactical-style color references

Urban Shadow combines black, charcoal and slate-grey camouflage with white graphics. Prefer green camouflage with yellow accents? Compare the Spec-Ops Jungle rash guard. Confirm fabric, measurements and artwork separately for each colorway.

Prepare a private-label sample brief

  1. Specify training use, size range, quantity per size and delivery destination.
  2. Approve the fabric, camo scale, graphic placement, neckline, sleeves and labels.
  3. Review a physical sample for fit, movement, seam comfort, print appearance and washing.

Reference images include existing neck-tape and small data-block lettering. Submit your own authorized branding and approve every label and artwork element for production.

Explore rash guard fabric construction, flatlock and overlock seams, sublimation logo placement and sample and MOQ planning.

Custom black-grey camo rash guard FAQ

Can the camouflage and industrial-style graphics be customized?

Yes. Provide authorized artwork, color references, logo placements and label requirements. Approve the camouflage scale, sleeve layout and chest graphics on an artwork proof and physical sample.

What are the fabric composition and GSM?

Final fiber composition, GSM, stretch and recovery are confirmed for the selected fabric. The supplied brief includes example values rather than a confirmed production specification.

Does the tactical design indicate military or protective certification?

No. Tactical and Spec-Ops describe the visual theme. This training garment is not presented as protective equipment or as military-certified apparel. Abrasion, moisture-management and durability requirements need agreed tests.

Are matching shorts included?

This product reference covers the short-sleeve rash guard. Matching shorts shown in styling photographs are a separate garment and require their own construction, sizing, quotation and sample approval.

Can it be used for No-Gi BJJ competitions?

Confirm the organizer’s current color, coverage, branding and garment rules before specifying a competition version. This reference does not establish event approval.

How do I request MOQ, pricing and a sample?

Send quantity by size, target market, delivery destination, artwork status and required date through the project builder. Confirm MOQ, sample costs, fabric, branding, lead time and packaging against the project brief.
